idea-plugin.name: E-Invoice Lint for XRechnung, Factur-X and UBL
idea-plugin.description:
Catches retired profile identifiers, code-list values outside EN 16931 and malformed dates in your e-invoice XML, in the editor, before an access point rejects the file.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → E-Invoice Lint for XRechnung, Factur-X and UBL: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 26 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/einvoice-lint-en16931 (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/einvoice-lint-en16931

action.text: E-Invoice Lint for XRechnung, Factur-X and UBL: Check This File
action.description: Run E-Invoice Lint for XRechnung, Factur-X and UBL on the file in the editor
